typography.instructions: Use JetBrains Mono for all numeric data, tables, logs, and primary headings to maintain the CAD/terminal aesthetic. Use IBM Plex Sans for longer reading text or secondary navigation.

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid #222222 on all cards. No rounded corners, or max rounded-sm (2px) for a sharp, rigid, technical feel.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal to none. Rely on 1px borders for separation. Hover states can use a subtle drop-shadow with the primary text color (e.g. shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(255,255,255,0.1)]).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid. Use solid dark backgrounds to maintain contrast and legibility.

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Dense. Use p-4 for cards, gap-4 for grids.

components.cards: Flat background (#111111), 1px subtle border (#222222), no shadow. Content aligned left.
components.tables: Dense rows, monospace text for IDs/Hostnames/Users, sticky headers, subtle hover state (bg-[#1A1A1A]).
components.buttons: Square or rounded-sm. Primary CTA uses a stark white background with black text (Swiss Brutalist inversion). Secondary buttons use outline with subtle grey hover.
components.editors: Options file / License file editors MUST use a monospace font, dark background (#000000), and syntax highlighting (green/amber/red for keywords).
components.status_indicators: Small pulsing dots or solid terminal blocks next to text (e.g. [UP] in green).
components.icons: Use Phosphor Icons (dense, readable) or Lucide. Size them small (16px/20px).

motion.hover: Instant or very fast (100ms) transitions for a snappy, zero-latency feel.
motion.focus: High contrast 2px solid ring, usually white or blue.
motion.loaders: ASCII spinners or fast terminal-style cursor blinks.

image_urls.description: Abstract dark technical grid pattern to be used as a subtle repeating or banner background behind the top nav or header, at low opacity (10-20%) so it doesn't distract from data.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure all text, especially grey/muted text, passes APCA/WCAG AA against the #050505 and #111111 backgrounds.
accessibility.focus_management: Ensure keyboard navigability with highly visible focus rings.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: You have .js files not .tsx file, so write components in JavaScript (.jsx/.js) syntax, NOT TypeScript.
Avoid using Shadcn's default Card styling if it's too soft/rounded. Override rounded corners to 'rounded-none' or 'rounded-sm' and remove heavy shadows.
For the code editor, implement a simple textarea or a syntax highlighter like PrismJS/react-simple-code-editor with JetBrains Mono.
Build a 4-column Control Room layout: top row for status cards, main area for live checkout table, side panel for daemon control and quick logs.
Use Phosphor icons (e.g., '@phosphor-icons/react') for sharp, technical iconography. If unavailable, use Lucide.
NEVER use Inter or generic sans for the main UI. Default to IBM Plex Sans, and heavily rely on JetBrains Mono for data points.
NEVER use gradient backgrounds for buttons or cards. Keep it matte, flat, and terminal-adjacent.
